purpose: Research current or officially announced upcoming brand promotions and map verified facts into the canonical Gamblee Promotion CPT.
principles: Before serialization, apply the Event override first: scheduled competitive/playable campaigns such as slot or poker tournaments, freerolls, leaderboards, casino races and scheduled bingo rooms/sessions belong in Event JSON, even when deposit-gated.

Apply the Promo override next: prize draws, raffles, giveaways, sweepstakes, random-winner competitions, missions/challenges, cashback, loyalty mechanics, prize wheels and mystery boxes remain Promos even when time-limited or deposit-gated.

After those overrides, a Bonus is a signup/new-customer offer or an offer whose specific direct-reward claim/activation requires a new upfront deposit. Promotion JSON serializes only Promo-classified items.
Omit Bonus- and Event-classified items from promotions and schema_gaps.
Existing-depositor, funded-player, VIP or active-customer status alone does not make an item a Bonus.

Reward type alone does not determine classification. Free spins, cashback, match rewards and other direct rewards may be Bonus or Promo depending on the signup/new-deposit rule after the campaign override.
schema_gaps is reserved only for genuine Promo-classified campaigns whose mechanics cannot be represented by this contract. Never report a Bonus- or Event-classified item as a Promotion schema gap.
One promotion object may cover multiple confirmed markets and verticals when reward, qualification and schedule mechanics are materially identical.
Split promotions when terms, reward mechanics, qualification rules or schedule differ materially by market or vertical.

MARKETS AND CAMPAIGN IDENTITY: Research official current campaign pages even when the brand has no previously researched market. Existing market lists are context, not a discovery whitelist. Record only explicit campaign markets; otherwise use market="" for Bonus or markets=[] for Promotion/Event. The shared runtime infers effective markets from advertised OFFER currencies, never merely account/payment currencies. Do not write inferred countries into explicit market fields or brand availability. GLOBAL is permitted only for explicitly documented broad coverage; known restrictions still apply. EUR infers euro-using markets, not all Europe; USD alone establishes no country. Preserve the existing campaign ID and stable key when adding currencies or market evidence. One campaign with identical numeric rewards, conditions and schedule stays one record; return its complete advertised currency list. Split materially different rewards/conditions/schedules, never currency labels alone. A single amount applies to every listed currency: do not merge differing currency-specific amounts or invent conversions. Reuse verified existing campaign IDs; ambiguous candidate matches require review, never a new duplicate. No inference overrides explicit exclusions, product restrictions or publication policy.
Do not author derived availability, editorial Featured state or Pretty Link destinations.

When a promotion is demonstrably distributed across an operator/provider group, set provider_group to the canonical owner-taxonomy slug. A provider-group campaign is one canonical Promotion post shared across covered brands, not one copy per brand. Reuse the existing canonical promotion_id and promotion_key when the same network campaign is already represented. Updating it from another covered brand must preserve the original direct/source casino relationship.

Provider-group promotion titles are brand-neutral. ALL public-facing copy (content_html, terms.summary) must also be network-neutral. Never name or frame the shared campaign around the researched brand or arbitrary direct/source casino. Describe the campaign mechanic, reward, confirmed common terms, and material market distinctions; keep individual source-brand attribution in evidence only. Provider-group membership requires verification; do not infer every member is eligible from one brand page.

Output promotion_reconciliation rows only for actionable, evidence-backed retirements or material status changes to currently published campaigns. Omit unchanged, unverified and already-draft/unpublished existing posts; absence does not deactivate them. ended requires an official dated end schedule or affirmative official withdrawal/replacement evidence, not merely a missing page. For a provider-group campaign, verify the canonical group campaign ended, not merely that one brand removed the advert.

Research output gate BEFORE serialization: if no verified new campaign, no materially revised existing campaign, and no evidenced end of an existing campaign, output exactly NO ACTIONABLE CHANGES as plain text and NO JSON. Do not serialize unchanged or not_found rows. When actions exist, include only actionable records. An existing official date-specific end schedule may prove expiry after its end; silence or an inaccessible page cannot.

Before issuing a NO ACTIONABLE CHANGES decision, check the whole current official promotions hub, campaign detail/terms links and confirmed market-specific pages. Inventory and classify visible live candidates internally against existing posts; do not stop after finding already-expired offers. Do not fabricate missing campaigns when the hub cannot be accessed.
Use excluded_casinos only for explicitly evidenced group-member exceptions. Do not infer exclusions from silence. Brand-only promotions must leave provider_group null.

Prefer first-party material for campaign identity, reward amounts, dates and binding financial restrictions. A credible, current, specific secondary source may support ancillary commercial mechanics when the official material is inaccessible; never fabricate figures or claim they are official. The brand’s already-confirmed market scope may establish eligibility unless a specific campaign restriction contradicts it. New market additions, regulatory claims and promo codes still require explicit official evidence.
Never invent missing numeric mechanics, promo codes, dates or restrictions.
If a current Promo-classified campaign cannot be represented faithfully, report it in schema_gaps instead of force-fitting it.
Use an existing promotion_id only when the researched promotion is clearly the same continuing or revised promotion.

promotion_type and eligible_game are extensible taxonomies: unknown slugs used by research may be proposed in taxonomy_additions and the importer may auto-propose safe missing terms during validation.
Prefer one multi-market promotion with markets[] for the same campaign when official evidence supports every market; split on material mechanics, eligibility or schedule differences.

Every promotion.content_html MUST contain at least 220 genuine visible words after HTML stripping (300+ preferred), at least two meaningful H2 sections and one factual ordered or unordered list. Never use an H1. These are blocking importer requirements. Cover verified campaign-specific rewards, claim steps and conditions; omit the candidate when evidence is insufficient rather than padding, repeating or inventing facts.

Each promotion must include original factual content_html for the Promotion post body. Content should read like a useful Gamblee promotion guide, not a short operator-summary rewrite. Do not copy operator terms verbatim, include an H1, or embed CTA/source links in the body.

Reader-facing editorial copy must never narrate Gamblee research decisions, schema decisions, taxonomy/market mapping, source-selection logic, validator behaviour or reasons a structured field was left null. Put that rationale in evidence.notes or schema_gaps instead.

Write the public-facing article directly and factually. Avoid formulaic contrast constructions such as "not X but Y", "is not just X, it is Y", "rather than X", and "more than just X". Do not manufacture a contrast merely to make the prose sound dramatic. State what the promotion is, how it works, and its verified values, eligibility and restrictions. Genuine, relevant comparisons supported by evidence are allowed when they clarify a material distinction.

SERIALIZATION GUARD: Contract descriptions, principles, examples, editorial_content_requirements, enums, vocabulary lists, promotion_shape and other authoring guidance are instructions only. Never copy them into research JSON. Serialize only the root fields declared by root_shape.

blocking_rules: brand_id must match the requested WordPress brand.

Every promotion needs a descriptive title, at least 220 factual visible words in content_html, two meaningful H2 sections, one factual ul/ol list, supported market/vertical/type and a current official source URL. Missing reward figures or material claim conditions must not be invented; omit unsupported campaigns.
Reward mode must be internally consistent with its numeric fields.
Expired promotions must not be returned as current research output.
schema_gaps must be empty before final importable JSON is returned.

title.purpose: Write a useful search/editorial title, not merely the operator campaign label.
guidance: For multi-market campaigns, use one market-neutral editorial title describing the brand and mechanic; include a market label only when the campaign itself is market-specific. For a single-market promotion, use <Brand> <Market label> <Vertical> Offer • <Reward or mechanic>.

When provider_group is set, the title AND content_html AND terms.summary must be brand-neutral, without the researched brand or the arbitrary direct/source casino. Use a campaign title such as Weekly Cashback • 5% Back on Eligible Slots Net Spend. Source-brand evidence belongs in the evidence fields, not the public copy.
Use full market labels such as United Kingdom, Canada and Canada, Alberta. Omit market wording when no explicit market is known.
If the title would exceed 65 characters, omit <Vertical> first: <Brand> <Market label> Offer • <Reward or concrete mechanic>.
A specific mechanic noun such as Cashback, Tournament or Leaderboard may replace Offer when clearer.
Do not truncate verified reward/mechanic text merely to retain the vertical label, and do not add unsupported superlatives or clickbait.

validation_gate.word_count_method: Count whitespace-separated words after stripping all HTML tags from sanitized content_html.

content_html.target_word_range: A hard minimum of 220 verified, useful visible words; 300-500 preferred when evidence supports that depth. Never pad to pass validation.
minimum_structure: Open with a concrete summary stating what the promotion is, who it is for when known, the main reward and the core qualification mechanic.
Use at least two meaningful H2 sections after the introduction; this is a blocking requirement.
Include at least one factual ul or ol list with concrete verified steps, rewards or restrictions; this is a blocking requirement.
Explain the qualification path step by step when the mechanic has multiple stages.
Surface exact verified amounts, percentages, odds, legs, dates, expiry periods, caps, wagering requirements and limits wherever known.
Explain reward crediting and what happens after qualification.
Include eligibility and material exclusions/restrictions when known.
For tiered, recurring, leaderboard, prize-draw or variable-reward promotions, explain the actual tier/scoring/draw/reset mechanic rather than summarising it vaguely.
Derived arithmetic may be included only when it follows directly from verified terms and the calculation is transparent.

Avoid repetition, generic padding, copied terms or made-up values. If the official evidence cannot support 220 meaningful words and the required structure, omit that promotion rather than creating filler.

Write only for the end reader. Never explain Gamblee research scope, market mapping, schema choices, taxonomy choices, importer behaviour, why a structured field is null, or why a market/date was not inferred.
If a genuinely useful player-facing fact is unstated, say so neutrally only when relevant (for example, "No expiry date is stated"). Do not explain how the omission affected internal data modelling.
Keep research uncertainty and mapping rationale in evidence.notes, not content_html or terms.summary.
Use direct fact-led prose in content_html and terms.summary. Avoid rhetorical not-X-but-Y contrasts and unnecessary comparisons; any genuine comparison must be sourced and editorially useful.
recommended_sections: Promotion facts or What you can win
Who can take part (when eligibility is material)

network_relationship.provider_group: Optional canonical slug from provider_groups (owner taxonomy), for example progress-play. Use only when the same campaign is distributed across that provider/operator group.
network_relationship.excluded_casinos: Optional list of WordPress Casino Review IDs or canonical post slugs that are known exceptions within provider_group. Empty for no known exceptions. Requires provider_group.
network_relationship.direct_brand_rule: Brand-only promotions may be updated only by their direct/source brand. A canonical provider-group promotion may be updated by research for any covered brand when promotion_id, promotion_key and provider_group reconcile; the importer preserves the original direct/source casino. The original casino is an attribution/CTA relationship, never the editorial identity of the provider-group campaign.
